authority: EXAMPLE of a client's intake rules. Replace with the client's own wording; the gate applies these rules in code (sys-firewall/rc-qa-gate/src/policy.js), never the model.

rules.scheduled: A call counts as Scheduled only when the intake outcome says an appointment was booked on the call.
rules.lost: A qualified caller who was not scheduled counts as Lost; record the reason from a fixed list (no next steps, will call back, pricing concerns, not qualified).
rules.revenue: Revenue is taken only from a real Value column supplied by the client; it is never estimated from the call.
rules.unassigned: A call answered by a shared line or a blank answerer is grouped as Unassigned, never credited to a person.

kpi_base: inbound calls only; outbound calls are graded for coaching and set aside
